rootCause: Rev12 remained one opaque surface. Its UV parallax, Fresnel and BRDF mixing had no spatially separated substrate, motif or crystal renderer.
architecture: Two cap assemblies. Each uses a cap-only substrate mesh, an alpha-tested motif mesh and a transparent crystal mesh nested inside the existing exterior boundary.
opticalDimensionsAuthority: user-authorized visual estimates; not measured production dimensions
srpBatcherLayout: Each shader uses one UnityPerMaterial CBUFFER.
estimatedMobileCost: Per visible face: substrate 3 texture + 1 cubemap sample, motif 2 texture + 1 cubemap sample on black pixels, crystal 1 opaque-color + 1 cubemap sample. Rev13 adds about 4 draw calls and one transparent cap overdraw layer versus rev12; no device GPU timing.
transparentSorting: Opaque substrate queue 2020; alpha-tested motif queue 2480 with ZWrite; crystal queue 3090 with DepthOnly prepass and transparent forward pass.
